card.name: Start of drug names beginning av-
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug name that starts with "av" (avapritinib, avanafil, avibactam, avatrombopag), often right after "of" or "decreases". Also fires on "gr" in myasthenia gravis and "ol" in olmesartan.
